files.convention: request #6.1b/c: feasible share (all targets; plurality stratum-weighted) and median L1 among feasible targets by rule x cap x rank group, for ceil / emp95 / emp99 and the cap-composition caps.

request #6.1a: per subset of the declared (fine-tune, base) pairs (all, chat, nochat, domain, nochatname) and OLLB task: pair count, emp95, emp99, mean/median gain, 95th percentile of the share of headroom closed, share of pairs gaining more than 10 points.
request #6.1a: the 540 pairs by Type of the fine-tune and Type of its base model, and counts by chat-like model name.
solver time-outs (censored count/share) and measured CPU seconds per dataset x design x cap x rule (HiGHS CPU, summed over targets).
request #6.3a: leader and runner-up under mean / median / min for each duplicate-name rule.
request #6.3a: OLLB group medians of L1 and infeasible share under duplicate-name rules best (delivered) / first / latest / worst, with change against best.
request #6.4a: items per HELM MMLU subject (checked identical across models), item size in points and binomial SE.
request #6.3b: items per OLLB task summed from n-samples of one results JSON for each of 60 randomly sampled models (HF results snapshot aa81ecc3; network needed to regenerate).
C2: Kendall tau between rule orderings (by median L1) in two dataset|cap cells within a rank group.
feasible share per dataset x design x cap x rule pooled over rank groups, Wilson CI; weighted=1 = stratum-weighted estimate for the sampled ordinal rules.
C4: Spearman rho and log10-rank slope of L1 and K versus the target's mean rank, feasible targets only, bootstrap CI for the slope.

request #6.2: power / linear / log fits of L1 against rank at cap ceil per dataset x design x rule, on group medians and on target-level values: coefficients, rmse_log10, rmse_L1, R2 on the L1 scale, preferred form by each criterion.
request #6.2: are the group medians of L1 at ceil monotone in rank? Group medians, decreases, and whether each decrease lies within the bootstrap intervals.
C6: paired eps=0.1 and ties-as-loss runs versus the main eps=1e-3 runs: changed feasibility, changed K, L1 ratio with bootstrap CI.
C6: mean rank of each rule (by median L1) over replicate draws with its 2.5-97.5% interval.

C6: per target (10 best models after the first) x rule: median and 2.5-97.5% replicate interval of L1/K under evaluation-noise (noise) or task-bootstrap resampling (R=100, seed 0); p_already_first, p_infeasible.
C6: HELM task-subset scaling: random subsets of n subjects (R=50, seed 0) by n x rule x target rank in subset: L1/K medians with replicate intervals, p_infeasible, gap_own_med.
C6: log-log slope of median L1 versus n per rule and target rank in the subset.
C6: data-slice sensitivity (raw / nomerge / top500) per cap x rule: feasible share, median L1/K over feasible targets, bootstrap CI.
C6: Kendall tau of each slice's rule ordering against the main OLLB ordering.
C2: paired per-target log10 ratio of each rule's L1 to the mean's (both feasible), bootstrap CI, paired Wilcoxon p with Holm correction.

request #6.4b: share of targets that can reach first when every model's task scores are clipped (at leader + h or at a per-task percentile), for mean/median/min on OLLB and HELM, with ceil or gain10 attack cap.
request #6.4b: the same by rank group.

per dataset x design x cap x rule x rank group (analyze.py): n targets, censored, infeasible count/rate (Wilson CI), median L1/K/Linf over all targets (infeasible = +inf) and over feasible targets only, with B=1000 percentile bootstrap CIs over targets.
C5: L1 / (n x Linf) per rule (targeted cost over the cost of a uniform improvement of the largest single jump), median and bootstrap CI.
20 Dirichlet(1) weight draws (seed 1000+k): min/median/max over draws of the group median L1/K and infeasible share, plus inverse-std weights (winvstd_*).
